content_md:
Webmentions are live on BradyDale.com and I think [Blynger on Github](https://github.com/BradyDale/Blynger) has what it needs to get a site there, but your agent would probably have to do some work fitting it to your host.

There's also a document written for agents in Github, from my agent, about what it learned building Webmentions, so maybe that can help speed your agent along.

Version 13!
